Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-polish-medium-0020", "row_sha256": "454162e4200fab1d3df7eba3ea35060af4ec1c5bfd87a10741fb82d253411088", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "the april seed exchange at north branch library had 38 people come through, and 12 of them were there for the first time. nine neighborhood groups brought seeds, and we had 214 packets on the tables when the exchange opened. we began at 10:20 instead of the posted 10:00 time because the delivery with the printed labels came later than expected. maya and i put labels on the packets while the first visitors waited, and two volunteers kept the check-in list.

we had 67 packets of beans, 51 of tomatoes, and 42 of herbs. the other 54 packets were split among flowers, squash, and greens, but the tally sheet doesn't give a separate number for each of those types. a few visitors asked whether they could take packets without leaving seeds in return, and we told them that was fine. the sign said there was no required trade, though we still invited people to bring seeds to a future exchange.

last assessment: the count is for packets recorded at the tables when the exchange opened, not for seeds weighed or handed out later. two boxes arrived without labels, so if their packets were not included in the opening tally, the total is incomplete; we haven't confirmed whether those boxes were counted.", "output": "The April seed exchange at North Branch Library had 38 attendees, 12 of whom were there for the first time. Nine neighborhood groups brought seeds, and there were 214 packets on the tables when the exchange opened. We began at 10:20 instead of the posted 10:00 time because the delivery of printed labels arrived later than expected. Maya and I labeled the packets while the first visitors waited, and two volunteers kept the check-in list.

There were 67 packets of beans, 51 of tomatoes, and 42 of herbs. The other 54 packets were split among flowers, squash, and greens, but the tally sheet doesn't give a separate count for each type. A few visitors asked whether they could take packets without leaving seeds in return, and we told them that was fine. The sign said no trade was required, though we still invited people to bring seeds to a future exchange.

Last assessment: The count covers packets recorded at the tables when the exchange opened, not seeds weighed or handed out later. Two boxes arrived without labels, so if their packets were not included in the opening tally, the total is incomplete. We haven't confirmed whether those boxes were counted."}]
